metadata.name: Pocasset V3 lidar-derived course features
metadata.note: Features missing from the OpenStreetMap course source, traced from the locked lidar. Each entry names its evidence. Never edits the OSM file; merged at read time by tools/pcv3.py course_features(). All unverified until checked on the course.

properties.evidence: Owner (15 Nov 2026): "a small pond right in front of the tee box" on Hole 8. 2021 USGS lidar: basin with a dead-flat floor at 5.0 m NAVD88 (hydro-flattened water surface), ~28 x 44 m, 25-45 m in front of the tees, 9 m below them.
properties.method: Cells of the locked 2 m course-area lidar grid connected to the flat surface and within 0.15 m of it; outline smoothed (0.75 cell Gaussian at 8x) and simplified to 0.4 m; area ~1,000 m2.
